name: Price Manipulation
description: Contract logic can be exploited via price manipulation

detectors.name: Balance-Dependent Price Calculation
detectors.description: Price depends on current balance which can be manipulated

detectors.name: Single Source Price Dependency
detectors.description: Only one price source used without validation

detectors.name: Donation Attack Vector
detectors.description: Share price can be manipulated via direct token transfer

remediation: Use multiple price sources with aggregation, implement slippage protection, use time-weighted prices, consider donation attacks in share calculations

historical.description: Curve pool price manipulation via flash loan
